purpose: Select a paper-reportable exploratory fusion configuration without the 44R1 qualification gates.
development_scope: 71 train + 15 validation runs; three-fold run-grouped CV
selection_objective: require every grouped-CV fold MAE ratio <= 1.0
require truth-defined development slope-region MAE ratio < 1.0
limit truth-defined development near-flat MAE increase to <= 0.01 deg
gate: observer valid AND TCN ready AND p_help threshold AND slope hysteresis AND innovation range AND NIS reject
Kmax_rationale: 1.0 is the largest convex observer weight; values above 1 extrapolate beyond R2_06 and are excluded from the paper-oriented grid.
claim_boundary: Six paths x one seed is descriptive. Paired inference requires six paths x ten fixed model seeds and hierarchical paired bootstrap.
paper_language: retrospective exploratory benchmark; R2_06 is not described as a qualified observer
